meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: component_aePROg2qSyYZEflT2_playbook
title: Flow 1
actions:
  Configure_Variables:
    title: Configure Variables
    type: createVariables
    description: >
      Initializes variables for tracking enrichment status, threat intelligence verdict, risk score, and record IDs
    on-success:
    - Count_Observables: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: Threat_Intelligence_Verdict
      value: ""
    - name: Enrichment_Complete
      value: false
    - name: TI_Record_Tracking_IDs
      value: []
    - name: Classification
      value: ""
    - name: Turbine_Risk_Score
      value: 
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 0ba2a9ca-e9b5-4d9a-9ed1-8ba77ece6bf4
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 44dad71d-0459-4932-a664-bf191b809b5b
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Count_Observables:
    title: Count Observables
    type: transformation
    description: >
      Counts the number of observable values provided in the component input
    on-success:
    - If_Observables_Present: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations:
      observable_count:
        title: Observable Count
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: count
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $inputs.Observable_Values
          advancedView: false
        inputs:
          expression: $count(inputs.Observable_Values)
          data:
            inputs:
              Observable_Values:
                $:ref: $inputs.Observable_Values
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ""
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
    entrypoint: observable_count
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  If_Observables_Present:
    title: If Observables Present
    type: conditional
    description: >
      Checks whether any observables exist to process; branches to appropriate path
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    conditions:
    - action: ForEach_Observable
      condition:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $actions.Count_Observables.result.observable_count
          - $:gt: 0
    else: Update_Variables_No_Observables
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 0e28eea8-52f2-4b16-a0a2-5194fb25c083
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    disabled: false
  Update_Variables_No_Observables:
    title: Update Variables (No Observables)
    type: updateVariables
    description: >
      Sets enrichment complete flag to true when no observables are provided for processing
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: Enrichment_Complete
      operation:
        type: set
        value: true
    - name: Classification
      operation:
        type: set
        value: Unknown
    - name: Threat_Intelligence_Verdict
      operation:
        type: set
        value: Unknown
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 58d0fcc9-9c27-4f62-9c21-fc14c4c7856f
    outputSchemaReferenceId: cd116dae-8d88-4747-85a3-208a95b98d82
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  ForEach_Observable:
    title: ForEach Observable
    type: loop
    description: >
      Iterates through each observable value in parallel to search for matching threat intelligence records
    on-success:
    - Aggregate_Loop_Results: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    entrypoints:
    - Search_TI_Records
    actions:
      Search_TI_Records:
        title: Search TI Records
        type: recordAction
        description: >
          Searches TI application for records matching the current observable value from the loop
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        inputs:
          applicationId: aGfR2rPsFvQq4lBU_
          limit: 1
          returnFields:
          - observable
          - observable-type
          - ti-last-updated
          - turbine-risk-score
          - threat-intelligence-verdict
          - tracking-id
          - requires-reenrichment
          filters:
          - fieldId: aflvc
            filterType: equals
            value: '{ $:ref: $loops.ForEach_Observable.value }'
          - fieldId: a1oh0
            filterType: equals
            value: 69de136dece5a42f9affd4b1
          filterType: AND
          applicationName: ""
        recordActionType: search
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
    loop:
      type: for
      each:
        $:ref: $inputs.Observable_Values
      parallel: true
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    disabled: false
  Aggregate_Loop_Results:
    title: Aggregate Loop Results
    type: transformation
    description: >
      Collects and consolidates all threat intelligence search results from the parallel loop iterations
    on-success:
    - Process_TI_Search_Results: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations:
      ti_records:
        title: TI Records
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: $distinct([actions.ForEach_Observable.result.'Search_TI_Records'.result.records])
          data:
            actions:
              ForEach_Observable:
                result:
                  $:ref: $actions.ForEach_Observable.result
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ""
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
    entrypoint: ti_records
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Update_Variables_Observables_Present:
    title: Update Variables (Observables Present)
    type: updateVariables
    description: >
      Updates variables with enrichment results including verdict, risk score, tracking IDs, and completion status
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: Enrichment_Complete
      operation:
        type: set
        value:
          $:ref: $actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.enrichment_complete
    - name: Threat_Intelligence_Verdict
      operation:
        type: set
        value: '{ $:ref: $actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.ti_verdict }'
    - name: TI_Record_Tracking_IDs
      operation:
        type: set
        value:
          $:ref: $actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.ti_record_tracking_ids
    - name: Classification
      operation:
        type: set
        value: '{ $:ref: $actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.classification }'
    - name: Turbine_Risk_Score
      operation:
        type: set
        value:
          $:ref: $actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.turbine_risk_score
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 97f32084-e23a-49ed-8bb9-a2699ad3e175
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 0fcf5a77-3dde-4fa4-b4e2-742d134537c1
  Process_TI_Search_Results:
    meta: {}
    title: Process TI Search Results
    type: transformation
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success:
    - Update_Variables_Observables_Present: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: Determine enrichment completion status, max verdict, max risk score, and TIA record tracking IDs.
    transformations:
      enrichment_results:
        title: Enrichment_Results
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: "(\n    /* Collect the list of search results returned from 'Search_TI_Records' for all observables. */\n    $search_results := [actions.ForEach_Observable.result.'Search_TI_Records'.result.records];\n    \n    /* Get the list of observable values that were input. */\n    $observables := inputs.Observable_Values;\n    \n    /* Filter the search results to only those that have a 'threat-intelligence-verdict' field. */\n    $search_results_for_verdict := $filter(\n        $search_results, \n        function($v) { $exists($v.'threat-intelligence-verdict') }\n    );\n\n    /* Determine the overall verdict by prioritizing verdicts in the order: */\n    /* malicious > suspicious > benign > unknown. */\n    /* If none exist, default to 'Unknown'. */\n    $verdict := ([\n        /* Find any verdicts marked as 'malicious' */\n        $search_results_for_verdict[\n            $lowercase($.'threat-intelligence-verdict' ? $.'threat-intelligence-verdict' : \"unknown\") = \"malicious\"\n        ],\n        /* Find any verdicts marked as 'suspicious' */\n        $search_results_for_verdict[\n            $lowercase($.'threat-intelligence-verdict' ? $.'threat-intelligence-verdict' : \"unknown\") = \"suspicious\"\n        ],\n        /* Find any verdicts marked as 'benign' */\n        $search_results_for_verdict[\n            $lowercase($.'threat-intelligence-verdict' ? $.'threat-intelligence-verdict' : \"unknown\") = \"benign\"\n        ],\n        /* Find any verdicts marked as 'unknown' */\n        $search_results_for_verdict[\n            $lowercase($.'threat-intelligence-verdict' ? $.'threat-intelligence-verdict' : \"unknown\") = \"unknown\"\n        ],\n        /* If none of the above, insert a fallback object with verdict 'Unknown' */\n        {\n            \"threat-intelligence-verdict\": \"Unknown\"\n        }\n    ])[0].'threat-intelligence-verdict'; /* Take the first matching verdict. */\n\n    {\n        /* Check if enrichment is \"complete\" by comparing the observable count to the count of search results with a verdict. */\n        \"enrichment_complete\": $count($observables) = $count($search_results[$.'threat-intelligence-verdict']),\n        \n        /* The determined verdict value. */\n        \"verdict\": $verdict,\n        \n        /* Classify the verdict as \"True Positive\" or \"False Positive\" based on verdict value. */\n        \"classification\": $lookup({\n            \"malicious\": \"True Positive\",\n            \"suspicious\": \"True Positive\",\n            \"benign\": \"False Positive\",\n            \"unknown\": \"Unknown\"\n        }, $lowercase($verdict)),\n        \n        /* Gather list of all 'tracking-id' values from the search results. */\n        \"ti_record_tracking_ids\": [\n            $search_results.'tracking-id'\n        ],\n        \n        /* Get the highest 'turbine-risk-score' among all search results. */\n        \"turbine_risk_score\": $max([$search_results.'turbine-risk-score'])\n    }\n)"
          data:
            actions:
              ForEach_Observable:
                result:
                  $:ref: $actions.ForEach_Observable.result
            inputs:
              Observable_Values:
                $:ref: $inputs.Observable_Values
        actionType: jsonata
        next: enrichment_complete
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      enrichment_complete:
        title: Enrichment Complete
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: lookup
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.enrichment_results
            - enrichment_complete
          advancedView: false
        inputs:
          expression: $lookup(actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.enrichment_results,'enrichment_complete')
          data:
            actions:
              Process_TI_Search_Results:
                result:
                  enrichment_results:
                    $:ref: $actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.enrichment_results
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ti_verdict
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      ti_verdict:
        title: TI Verdict
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: lookup
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.enrichment_results
            - verdict
          advancedView: false
        inputs:
          expression: $lookup(actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.enrichment_results,'verdict')
          data:
            actions:
              Process_TI_Search_Results:
                result:
                  enrichment_results:
                    $:ref: $actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.enrichment_results
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ti_record_tracking_ids
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      ti_record_tracking_ids:
        title: TI Record Tracking IDs
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: lookup
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.enrichment_results
            - ti_record_tracking_ids
          advancedView: false
        inputs:
          expression: $lookup(actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.enrichment_results,'ti_record_tracking_ids')
          data:
            actions:
              Process_TI_Search_Results:
                result:
                  enrichment_results:
                    $:ref: $actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.enrichment_results
        actionType: jsonata
        next: classification
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      classification:
        title: Classification
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: lookup
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.enrichment_results
            - classification
          advancedView: false
        inputs:
          expression: $lookup(actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.enrichment_results,'classification')
          data:
            actions:
              Process_TI_Search_Results:
                result:
                  enrichment_results:
                    $:ref: $actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.enrichment_results
        actionType: jsonata
        next: turbine_risk_score
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      turbine_risk_score:
        title: Turbine Risk Score
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: lookup
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.enrichment_results
            - turbine_risk_score
          advancedView: false
        inputs:
          expression: $lookup(actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.enrichment_results,'turbine_risk_score')
          data:
            actions:
              Process_TI_Search_Results:
                result:
                  enrichment_results:
                    $:ref: $actions.Process_TI_Search_Results.result.enrichment_results
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ""
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
    entrypoint: enrichment_results
meta:
  enabled: true
description: ""

- Configure_Variables
pool: ""

    $:ref: $variables.Turbine_Risk_Score
  TI_Record_Tracking_IDs:
    $:ref: $variables.TI_Record_Tracking_IDs
  Classification: '{ $:ref: $variables.Classification }'
environment: {}
triggers: {}
